notes.title: Update 1.7.0 Orphanage Beta Access
notes.notes:
Orphanage Beta Map included in Full Game for the purposed of public beta testing for bug reports and community suggestions.

Currently we are testing weather all required pickups can be picked up and delivered to ritual to complete game.

All feedback appreciated. Prizes to be won, included brand new game keys for top feedback contributions.

All Story Cinematic's Removed for Full Version. Achievements may or may not work. Localization still to be added. Various Polish still required.

This map is a complete different game play from the usual perspective of attacking demons. Currently you as priests who have no weapons, and you need to flee the enemy while looking for ritual items. Coupled with the atmosphere of the environment, this should be a scarier / creepier experience. 

Final boss yet to be inserted to focus on pickups. Thank for you interest and support.

notes.title: BIBLE CAMP RELEASE DATE + TEASE TRAILER
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/6dc99d3e8ff2c4dca15174ffb32b813f0b93a823.jpg[/img]
[h2]New map bible camp release date + tease trailer[/h2]

Thanks to everyone who participated in the beta and offered feedback. We have put to use all of your suggestions and bug reports and that map has improved considerably because of it. So again, THANK YOU FOR ALL BETA FEEDBACK! You know who you are! We thank you very much!

[h2]Release date announcement teaser[/h2]
Today we have included a teaser trailer as part of the release date announcement and revealed the main characters behind the story of bible camp with additional details below.

[previewyoutube=xE5zjcWvQDw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]BIBLE CAMP - NEW MAP DETAILS[/h2]
As you may already know, the new map takes place in a remote bible camp lake cabin resort. A terrible incident occurred which left the place abandoned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/1a19b3af79f0f74ca4b92f89b16bcfb626be86c3.png[/img]

Players will have [b]2 new weapons[/b] to deal with the possessed and the demons just waiting to feast on your teams souls. The first weapon [b]The Bible[/b] when summoned will temporarily exorcise the feral children who were lost and abandoned deep in the forest from the demonic spirits that possessed them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/6637dc0b0dff899647e993e048d6f4eed39a614f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/5e972016f29a29be3d6e0b58694c4dc1be26e608.jpg[/img]

Once a feral child has been acquired, your team will need to take it to one of the spiritual ritual pulpits spread across the area. You will need to read sermons while the demons attempt to stop you. It will not be easy, may the lord be with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/0da988bb0524823f3c508b5190b6bc952bcf3845.jpg[/img]

The second weapon is [b]The Orthodox Cross[/b]. This is a much more powerful weapon when compared to earlier crosses used. But requires patience with the lord to regain the lords favor. Be careful and wise to used such power, it may be the difference between life and death.
P.s Only use it against the flying one! May the lord protect you child.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/c30ef8b33f6a6279602fc80bf584cade317a1fe5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/e53244a9b4eff76d88589e2fbf1b70adfcde564a.jpg[/img]

There are many types of demons in this map, ranging from ground runners, to Jumpers, and of course the Flying one. I suggest your teams prepare for this encounter , and fight off the reaper and werewolves in the village, and then exorcist the possessed demonic daughter before embarking on such a dangerous endeavor. Good luck God's Children!

[h2]Bible camp release date[/h2]
The new map will release on [b]JUNE 1[/b], just before the weekend for you and your friends to enjoy.
Gather your friends and pray. May the lord be with you!

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE : FORGIVENESS UPDATE
notes.notes:
GAME UPDATE # V 1.2.2

[h3]Please show us your support and rate the game so we can keep making new maps for you guys![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/9eac31005c3f202d67e2f84bd4d9330497657bac.gif[/img]

A substantial amount of users have voiced there opinion about the game being to difficult and not very fun. We wanted an intense experience but still FUN.

Therefor we aim to reduce the NOVICE and NORMAL Game Difficulty Settings and make a significant adjustment to the Village game play to support a more FUN experience. Where you can drop back in for a more casual game with your friends where your not instantly punished for lowering your guard.

For those of you who want to challenge evil intensely, 'a fight to the death', you can select HARD to get the previous NORMAL Settings. [Warning! REAPER INSTA-KILLS]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]

[list]
[*]VILLAGE MAP DIFFICULTY REVAMP [BOTH MULTIPLAYER + SINGLE PLAYER]

[LESS REPETITIVE OBJECTIVES [JACK-O-LANTERNS, SCISSORS REMOVED]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41751083/cd3d3c7dfd80df76893e12ca08613660d470fbdc.jpg[/img]

[b]PATCH LIST[/b]

[list]
